title: Lunar Crustal Magnetic Field Heterogeneity and Implications for Biological Systems at Candidate Landing Sites
description: Analysis pipeline, publication-quality figures, and interactive WebGL visualization for lunar crustal magnetic field data from NASA PDS (Lunar Prospector and SELENE/Kaguya missions). Includes a systematic review of hypomagnetic field effects on terrestrial biology and a risk assessment framework for biological systems at candidate lunar landing sites including Artemis III regions.
notes: Accompanying data pipeline, manuscript LaTeX source, and figures formatted for Nature Publishing Group submission. All raw magnetometer data sourced from NASA Planetary Data System (PDS).
